CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_mv2_external_message_identity
        ON mv2_import_receipts(character_id,external_conversation_id,external_message_id)
        WHERE external_conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND external_message_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_mv2_one_open_job
      ON mv2_jobs(character_id) WHERE status IN ('running','paused')

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_mv3_automatic_input
      ON mv3_versions(derivation_id,input_hash,author_kind)
      WHERE author_kind IN ('rule','model')
triggers:
CREATE TRIGGER mv3_a32_decision_owner BEFORE INSERT
        ON mv3_entry_tag_decisions BEGIN
        SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM mv3_entries e JOIN mv3_vocabulary v
            ON v.id=NEW.tag_id JOIN characters c ON c.id=e.character_id
            WHERE e.id=NEW.entry_id AND e.character_id=NEW.character_id
            AND v.character_id=NEW.character_id AND v.kind='tag' AND c.enabled=1)
        THEN RAISE(ABORT,'tag_decision_scope_invalid') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER mv3_a32_proposal_owner BEFORE INSERT
        ON mv3_tag_proposal_revisions BEGIN
        SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM mv3_entries e JOIN characters c ON c.id=e.character_id
            WHERE e.id=NEW.entry_id AND e.character_id=NEW.character_id AND c.enabled=1)
        OR (NEW.tag_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM mv3_vocabulary v WHERE v.id=NEW.tag_id
            AND v.character_id=NEW.character_id AND v.kind='tag'))
        THEN RAISE(ABORT,'tag_proposal_scope_invalid') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER mv3_a3_child_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON mv3_model_chunks
            WHEN NEW.state IN ('possibly_dispatched','unknown')
            AND (SELECT status FROM mv3_jobs WHERE id=NEW.job_id)!='unknown'
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'a3_parent_must_be_unknown'); END

CREATE TRIGGER mv3_a3_hold_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON mv3_jobs
        WHEN NEW.status!='unknown' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mv3_a3_migration_holds WHERE job_id=NEW.id)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'legacy_reconciliation_required'); END

CREATE TRIGGER mv3_a3_parent_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON mv3_jobs
            WHEN NEW.status!='unknown' AND EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM mv3_model_chunks WHERE job_id=NEW.id
             AND state IN ('possibly_dispatched','unknown'))
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'a3_unsettled_child'); END
